materialNarrowings.reason: The relational abstraction is valuable precisely because it is not the physical storage plan; practical success narrows any reading that treats representation separation as an argument against powerful abstraction.
Hidden optimization adds complexity, but the point is to repay it by making declarative queries competitive with hand-written access paths; overhead is workload-conditioned.
Within an interoperability regime a common fixed standard can be locally superior to continual operator switching; conditionality applies across relevant worlds, not every local choice.
Temporary voluntary restraint and later containment show scoped admissibility can preserve frontier legitimacy/capability; authority boundaries can expand after evidence and safeguards change.
Commercial viability generalizes beyond one electrochemical demonstration to repeated cycling, abuse and manufacture; higher energy alone is not the target.
A lower-risk architecture can dominate a locally higher-energy chemistry when repeated failure/safety costs are included.
Useful subsystem results do not establish the declared general whole-system objective; failure of that objective does not imply every component contribution was worthless.
Large coordinated research can generate spillovers while still failing to repay itself on its declared whole-system objective; cost/value must bind the stated objective and horizon.
Supersonic technical performance diverged from economics, noise, route constraints and environmental legitimacy; technical speed was not a sufficient success axis.
